rationale: PINS the LOCAL-BINDING claim class (contract validation/m14/verification/JAVASCRIPT-LOCAL-BINDING-CONTRACT.md): a name the file binds lexically is published with the family separator spelling `${edge.source}\u0000${name}` plus metadata.localBinding, which the arbiter verifies as a SPELLING (gate bindOK column, never merged into resolved). Positive shapes: parameter read, const read, nested function-declaration call, local function-expression call, `new` of a locally bound class expression, `instanceof` over a local type, catch binding, `var` hoisted out of a block, destructured parameter names. NEGATIVE CONTROLS: a MODULE-SCOPE declaration (`moduleConstant`) is a published symbol and must stay bare (the edge may resolve); an IMPORT binding (`importedThing`) and a `require(...)` binding (`fsMod`) belong to the imported-binding seam class and must NOT be claimed as local bindings. The forbid list pins the bare spelling of every claimed row, so dropping the separator is a red suite, not a silent regression. The prefix is the analyzer's OWN edge source (method or enclosing function), matching the family convention php/dart/java use.

expectRelationships.comment: read of a const in the enclosing function
call of a nested function declaration
var hoists out of the block, still a function-scope binding
method body binding, source is the enclosing METHOD
NEGATIVE: module-scope declaration is a published symbol -> bare, no claim
NEGATIVE: import binding belongs to the seam class
NEGATIVE: require() binding is a module binding, seam class

forbidRelationships.comment: the bare spelling must be gone for a claimed binding read
bare spelling gone for a claimed local call
a published module-scope symbol must never be claimed as a binding
import bindings are the seam class, not local bindings
require() bindings are the seam class, not local bindings
